items.title: How Many Shares of Coca-Cola or PepsiCo Pay $1,000 a Month in Dividends?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAt today’s prices, collecting $1,000 a month in dividends takes 5,661 shares of Coca-Cola, about $549,100, or 2,028 shares of PepsiCo, about $285,000. PepsiCo looks like the better buy for that income, as long as its turnaround gets its free cash flow growing again.

items.title: The Dividend Investing Strategy That Made Geraldine Weiss a Wall Street Legend
